shadow_trades.reasoning_summary: Trading away my only A to get a second B would leave me with 0 A, 1 C, 2 B - reducing variety rather than improving it. Since I value variety, this would decrease my utility.
This trade would give me 2A, 1C, 0B, reducing variety instead of improving it. Since I value variety, going to zero in B is worse than my current balanced 1-1-1 holding.
Giving up my only B to get 2 more A (already have A) would leave me with zero B and an oversupply of A, hurting my preference for variety. I'd rather negotiate a more balanced trade.

Trading C for B would just swap equal holdings (1 each) to 2B/0C, reducing variety rather than improving it. Since I value variety and currently have equal amounts of all three goods, this trade doesn't help - it would leave me with 0 of C, decreasing diversity.
Trading away B to go to 0 while increasing C to 2 would create imbalance (2,0,1) instead of my current balanced (1,1,1). Since I value variety, this trade reduces utility rather than increasing it.
This trade would leave me with 0 B and 3 C, reducing variety even though total goods count stays the same. I prefer a more balanced bundle, so I'll decline and seek a trade that maintains diversity.
